title: RATIONALYST: Pre-training Process-Supervision for Improving Reasoning
authors_zh: Dongwei Jiang、Guoxuan Wang、Yining Lu、Andrew Wang、Jingyu Zhang、Chuyu Liu、Benjamin Van Durme、Daniel Khashabi
paper_type_zh: 弱验证驱动的过程监督数据构建论文
best_for_zh: 研究隐式 rationale、弱验证器、过程监督、测试时步骤选择与数据发布审计的读者
one_line: Reports a 79K implicit-rationale mixture filtered by future-token predictiveness and trains an 8B process supervisor, while the linked 15178-row dataset leaves the full release unreconciled.
论文报告用后续 token 可预测性筛得约 7.9 万条隐式 rationale，并训练 8B 过程监督器；但官方链接数据集只有 15,178 行，完整发布尚未对齐。
why: It makes a weak, scalable verifier contract concrete and shows why predictive filtering, source lineage, release completeness, and rationale validity must be audited separately.
inclusion_reason: An ACL construction recipe that turns unlabeled continuation predictiveness into weak process supervision, then reuses the learned rationale object for test-time step selection; it is especially informative about the gap between a scalable proxy and auditable rationale validity.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Process supervision usually requires a step-level judge, expert annotations, or a task environment that can check intermediate actions. These signals are costly and are often unavailable for ordinary web text. Yet explanatory writing and worked solutions contain transitions where an unstated motive or inference could help predict what comes next. The paper asks whether those latent rationales can be inserted automatically and selected without gold process labels.

That question has two distinct parts. The construction problem is to turn preceding text, an inserted rationale, and following text into a reusable training object. The deployment problem is to use the learned rationale generator to guide an agent's next reasoning step. RATIONALYST connects them through a predictive proxy: a rationale is useful when conditioning on it makes the observed continuation more likely. This is scalable, but it is weaker than verifying that the rationale is logically sound.

过程监督通常需要步骤级判别器、专家标注，或能够检查中间动作的任务环境。这些信号成本高，而且普通网页文本往往不具备。另一方面，解释性写作和带解答的题目包含许多衔接点：某个未明说的动机或推断可能有助于预测后文。论文的问题是，能否自动插入这些潜在 rationale，并在没有 gold 过程标签的情况下筛选它们。

这个问题包含两个不同环节。构建环节要把前文、插入的 rationale 和后文变成可复用训练对象；部署环节则要用学到的 rationale 生成器指导 agent 的下一推理步骤。RATIONALYST 用预测性代理连接两者：如果以某段 rationale 为条件时，已观察到的后文概率更高，就认为它有用。这一信号可扩展，但证据强度低于验证 rationale 的逻辑正确性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central data object is a triple: preceding context, an implicit rationale inserted at a sentence or solution-step boundary, and the following context. Llama-3-8B-Instruct proposes the rationale. A 0.9-decayed future-token score compares the continuation with and without that rationale; the intended filter keeps rationales that improve continuation prediction by enough to pass a source-specific threshold.

The paper reports about 79K retained rationales: about 65K from six Pile subdomains and about 14K from GSM8K and ECQA. These targets supervise an 8B RATIONALYST model to predict a rationale from the current context. At test time, RATIONALYST supplies an implicit rationale, the agent samples three candidate next steps, and a rationale-conditioned likelihood score selects one. Thus the learned object is used both as an SFT target and as a search-side latent guide.

The feedback contract is deliberately weak. It measures whether a rationale explains or anticipates the observed continuation, not whether every intermediate assertion is valid. The released artifacts sharpen that distinction: the linked dataset exposes only preceeding, rationale, and following, without the scores, thresholds, source identifiers, or retention decisions needed to reconstruct the filter.

核心数据对象是一个三元组：前文、插在句子或解题步骤边界处的隐式 rationale，以及后文。Llama-3-8B-Instruct 负责提出 rationale；带 0.9 指数衰减的后续 token 分数比较加入和不加入该 rationale 时的后文预测。过滤器的设计意图是：只有预测改善幅度达到来源特定阈值时才保留。

论文报告共保留约 7.9 万条 rationale，其中约 6.5 万条来自六个 Pile 子域，约 1.4 万条来自 GSM8K 与 ECQA。这些目标用于监督训练 8B RATIONALYST，使其根据当前上下文预测 rationale。测试时，RATIONALYST 给出隐式 rationale，agent 每步采样 3 个候选下一步骤，再用以该 rationale 为条件的似然选择一个。因此，同一个学习对象既是 SFT 目标，也是搜索阶段的潜在引导信号。

这里的反馈契约有意采用弱信号：它衡量 rationale 是否能解释或预示已观察到的后文，并不验证每个中间陈述是否成立。公开 artifact 更突出了这个区别：链接数据集只暴露 preceeding、rationale 和 following，没有重建过滤所需的分数、阈值、来源标识或保留决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
Pile construction begins with a semantic prefilter. The paper names Pile-CC, StackExchange, GitHub, HackerNews, PubMed Central, and English Wikipedia as the retained subdomains. The released script averages all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings over reference examples from GSM8K, ECQA, ARC-Challenge, and ProofWriter, then keeps Pile text with cosine similarity at least 0.3. The length rule is not reproducibly specified: the methodology says 2,000-word segments, the experiment section says fewer than 2,000 tokens, and the code applies Python len(text), which is a character count.

Llama-3-8B-Instruct is prompted with demonstrations to insert rationales between the literal BOT and EOT delimiter tokens while leaving the surrounding text unchanged. For GSM8K and ECQA, prompts instruct the model not to put the answer inside a rationale. The released extraction script uses temperature 0.0, seed 14, and a 3,000-token output cap, but its input list also includes MATH and MMLU-Pro; the paper's reported final mixture names only GSM8K, ECQA, and the six Pile subdomains.

For a rationale at position i, the paper weights future-token loss by powers of 0.9. It reports thresholds 1.2 for GSM8K, 0.5 for ECQA, and 0 for all Pile sources. A manually labeled positive/negative set of 100 examples is used to select the task-data thresholds for a stated 95% retained-rationale accuracy target; the paper does not clearly say this is 100 examples per dataset. Pile rationales receive no comparable labeled calibration.

The retained pairs train RATIONALYST with token-level cross-entropy, masking the prompt and predicting the rationale. The public example job specifies 20 epochs, learning rate 2e-5, per-device batch size 2, gradient accumulation 8, warmup ratio 0.03, cosine scheduling, and two-GPU FSDP, but the paper does not confirm that file as the exact reported run.

At inference, RATIONALYST generates a rationale for the current trajectory. Llama-3-8B-Instruct samples three next-step candidates at temperature 0.7; the released implicit method chooses the candidate with the highest 0.9-decayed token log-probability conditioned on that rationale. The script uses seed 14 and at most 15 iterations, stopping earlier on a dataset-specific answer cue. No external correctness verifier or executable environment evaluates the chosen step.

Pile 构建首先进行语义预筛选。论文列出的保留子域为 Pile-CC、StackExchange、GitHub、HackerNews、PubMed Central 和英文 Wikipedia。公开脚本用 all-mpnet-base-v2 对 GSM8K、ECQA、ARC-Challenge 与 ProofWriter 参考样本求平均嵌入，再保留余弦相似度至少为 0.3 的 Pile 文本。长度规则没有被可复现地统一说明：方法部分写 2,000 word 分段，实验部分写少于 2,000 token，而代码对文本执行 Python len(text)，实际计算字符数。

Llama-3-8B-Instruct 在示例提示下把 rationale 插入字面量 BOT 与 EOT 分隔 token 之间，并被要求不改变周围文本。对 GSM8K 和 ECQA，提示还要求不要把答案放入 rationale。公开抽取脚本使用温度 0.0、seed 14 和 3,000 token 输出上限，但脚本输入列表还包含 MATH 与 MMLU-Pro；论文报告的最终混合只列出 GSM8K、ECQA 和六个 Pile 子域。

对位置 i 的 rationale，论文以 0.9 的幂衰减加权后续 token 损失。报告阈值为 GSM8K 1.2、ECQA 0.5、所有 Pile 来源 0。作者用一个含 100 个正负样本的人工标注集选择任务数据阈值，并以保留 rationale 达到 95% 准确率为目标；论文没有清楚说明每个数据集是否各有 100 条。Pile rationale 没有同类标注校准。

保留样本通过 token 级交叉熵训练 RATIONALYST：遮蔽 prompt，只预测 rationale。公开示例任务配置为训练 20 个 epoch、学习率 2e-5、每设备 batch size 2、梯度累积 8、warmup ratio 0.03、cosine 调度和双 GPU FSDP，但论文没有确认该文件就是报告结果使用的精确运行配置。

推理时，RATIONALYST 根据当前轨迹生成 rationale。Llama-3-8B-Instruct 以温度 0.7 采样 3 个下一步骤候选；公开的隐式方法用该 rationale 作为条件，选择 0.9 衰减 token log-probability 最高的候选。脚本使用 seed 14，最多迭代 15 次，并可因数据集特定答案提示提前停止。所选步骤没有经过外部正确性验证器或可执行环境检查。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main experiment compares implicit RATIONALYST supervision with the Llama-3-8B-Instruct baseline on seven exact-match benchmarks. The reported scores are 77.6→81.6 on GSM8K, 28.0→32.5 on MATH, 72.6→75.2 on ECQA, 58.2→60.3 on HellaSwag, 86.4→90.7 on ProofWriter, 77.6→80.7 on ARC-Challenge, and 39.6→45.3 on MMLU-Pro. The reported mean gain is 3.9 points.

The evaluation covers GSM8K test (1,319), MATH test (5,000), ECQA validation (17,944), HellaSwag validation (10,000), ProofWriter depth-greater-than-5 test (600), ARC-Challenge test (1,172), and MMLU-Pro test (12,000). Removing Pile rationales lowers all seven reported scores, with drops from 0.7 on ECQA to 4.1 on MMLU-Pro. This supports a contribution from the data mixture under the paper's setup, but it does not isolate rationale truth from additional training, source-domain cues, or the search procedure.

For task-specific training only, Table 4 reports implicit versus explicit guidance of 80.3 versus 77.5 on GSM8K and 74.5 versus 72.2 on ECQA. The authors interpret implicit likelihood scoring as more robust to imperfect rationales than directly exposing them to the agent. Table 5 also compares process and outcome verifiers, but contains an unresolved ECQA inconsistency: it gives full RATIONALYST 76.2, whereas Table 2 and the official model card give 75.2.

Table 1 supplies unusually useful construction evidence: candidate counts, retention percentages, and thresholds for all eight source groups. However, the release evidence is weaker. The official dataset viewer shows 15,178 rows in one train split with three fields, while the paper reports roughly 79K retained rationales. Without a manifest that reconciles those quantities, the experiments support the method's reported utility but not complete public availability or per-record data quality.

主实验在七个 exact-match 基准上比较隐式 RATIONALYST 监督与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 基线。报告分数分别为：GSM8K 77.6→81.6、MATH 28.0→32.5、ECQA 72.6→75.2、HellaSwag 58.2→60.3、ProofWriter 86.4→90.7、ARC-Challenge 77.6→80.7、MMLU-Pro 39.6→45.3；平均提升为 3.9 个百分点。

评测包含 GSM8K test（1,319）、MATH test（5,000）、ECQA validation（17,944）、HellaSwag validation（10,000）、ProofWriter depth>5 test（600）、ARC-Challenge test（1,172）和 MMLU-Pro test（12,000）。移除 Pile rationale 后，七项报告分数都下降，降幅从 ECQA 的 0.7 到 MMLU-Pro 的 4.1。这说明在论文设置下数据混合有贡献，但不能把 rationale 真值、额外训练、来源域线索和搜索过程的作用分离开来。

只使用任务特定数据训练时，Table 4 报告 GSM8K 上隐式与显式指导为 80.3 对 77.5，ECQA 上为 74.5 对 72.2。作者据此认为，相比直接向 agent 暴露不完美 rationale，隐式似然评分更稳健。Table 5 还比较过程与结果验证器，但存在未解决的 ECQA 不一致：完整 RATIONALYST 被写为 76.2，而 Table 2 与官方 model card 均为 75.2。

Table 1 提供了难得的构建证据：八个来源组各自的候选数、保留比例与阈值。然而，发布证据较弱。官方数据集 viewer 只显示一个 train split、15,178 行和 3 个字段，而论文报告约 7.9 万条保留 rationale。缺少对齐这些数量的 manifest 时，实验支持方法在报告设置下的效用，却不能证明完整数据已经公开，也不能证明逐条数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
RATIONALYST turns an ordinary language-modeling quantity into a weak process-supervision contract. Instead of asking a human or symbolic checker whether an intermediate step is valid, it asks whether a proposed latent explanation improves prediction of what follows. This allows rationale targets to be mined from both worked reasoning datasets and unlabeled text.

The second contribution is object reuse across lifecycle stages. The mined rationale is not only a pre-training/SFT target; the trained generator later supplies trajectory-conditioned information for selecting the agent's next step. This creates a direct bridge from data construction to test-time search without training a separate outcome reward model.

The novelty should not be described as verified reasoning-data generation. Predictive utility, logical validity, and downstream correctness are different properties. The paper is most valuable as a concrete example of a scalable weak verifier whose benefits and failure modes can be studied across construction, filtering, training, and inference.

RATIONALYST 把普通语言建模量转化为一种弱过程监督契约。它不让人类或符号检查器判断中间步骤是否有效，而是询问某个潜在解释能否改善后文预测。因此，rationale 目标既可从带解答的推理数据中挖掘，也可从无标注文本中挖掘。

第二个贡献是让同一对象跨生命周期复用。挖掘出的 rationale 不只是预训练/SFT 目标；训练后的生成器还会在推理时提供以当前轨迹为条件的信息，用于选择 agent 的下一步骤。这在不另行训练 outcome reward model 的情况下，直接连接了数据构建与测试时搜索。

其创新不应被表述为“生成了经过验证的推理数据”。预测效用、逻辑有效性和下游正确率是不同属性。该工作最有价值的地方，是提供一个可扩展弱验证器的具体案例，使构建、过滤、训练与推理阶段的收益和失败模式都可以被审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The filter is a proxy rather than a correctness certificate. A rationale can raise the likelihood of an observed continuation by repeating cues, summarizing earlier text, or rationalizing a known continuation after the fact. Appendix H is especially important: the authors' manual review says most retained Pile rationales describe the preceding context rather than guide future reasoning. The Pile threshold is zero and is not calibrated on labeled rationale validity.

Several published details conflict. The paper's definition of the loss difference and its retention inequality do not agree with the prose that a rationale should reduce loss; the released code instead compares conditioned and baseline token log-probabilities. The Pile length cap is described as 2,000 words, 2,000 tokens, and implemented as 2,000 characters. ECQA is 75.2 in Table 2 and the official model card but 76.2 in Table 5. These should be treated as unresolved reporting issues, not silently harmonized.

Release completeness is also unresolved. The linked HF dataset has 15,178 rows with preceeding, rationale, and following, no dataset card, and no license. That size does not match the reported 79K mixture and does not obviously match Table 1's implied retained GSM8K count. It lacks source IDs, filter scores, thresholds, and a manifest. The inspected GitHub revision has no LICENSE, references absent filtering/parsing scripts, and contains cluster-specific paths. The HF model's Apache-2.0 declaration does not license the dataset or code.

No broad decontamination analysis was identified, although GSM8K and ECQA training sets feed construction and their test/validation sets feed evaluation. Preventing the answer from appearing inside a generated rationale reduces one leakage channel but is not a benchmark-overlap audit. Exact reported-run hyperparameters and package revisions remain unknown.

The paper itself notes limited task and comparison coverage, limited study of data-mixture choices, no DPO experiment, and compute constraints that prevented scaling to stronger models or a corpus such as OpenWebMath. Benchmark gains therefore establish neither generality nor rationale quality.

该过滤器是代理信号，不是正确性证书。rationale 可能通过复述词汇线索、概括前文，或对已知后文进行事后合理化来提高后文似然。Appendix H 尤其关键：作者的人工复核指出，大多数保留的 Pile rationale 描述的是前文，而不是指导后续推理。Pile 阈值为 0，也没有用带标签的 rationale 有效性进行校准。

论文和 artifact 中有多处冲突。论文对 loss difference 的定义及保留不等式，与“rationale 应降低损失”的文字说明不一致；公开代码实际比较的是有无 rationale 条件下的 token log-probability。Pile 长度上限分别被描述为 2,000 word、2,000 token，并在代码中实现为 2,000 character。ECQA 在 Table 2 和官方 model card 中为 75.2，在 Table 5 中却为 76.2。这些都应保留为未解决的报告问题，不能暗中统一。

发布完整性同样未解决。链接 HF 数据集有 15,178 行，字段为 preceeding、rationale、following，没有 dataset card，也没有 license。该规模既不匹配报告的 7.9 万混合，也不能显然对应 Table 1 隐含的 GSM8K 保留数；数据还缺少来源 ID、过滤分数、阈值和 manifest。检查的 GitHub revision 没有 LICENSE，README 引用的过滤/解析脚本缺失，并包含集群特定路径。HF 模型的 Apache-2.0 声明不能替数据集或代码授权。

没有发现广泛去污染分析，尽管 GSM8K 与 ECQA 的训练集参与构建，而其 test/validation 集参与评测。禁止答案出现在生成 rationale 中只能减少一种泄漏路径，不等于基准重叠审计。报告运行使用的精确超参数与包版本仍未知。

论文自身还指出：任务与比较覆盖有限、数据混合选择研究不足、没有 DPO 实验，以及计算约束使作者无法扩展到更强模型或 OpenWebMath 一类语料。因此，基准提升既不能证明普适性，也不能证明 rationale 质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, this paper is a compact case study in building process supervision when no correctness verifier is available. It specifies a source mixture, a generated data object, a predictive filtering signal, source-specific thresholds, an SFT target, and a downstream search consumer. Those layers make it useful for comparing weakly verified recipes with datasets filtered by executors, symbolic solvers, or expert process labels.

Practitioners can reuse the conceptual schema—source, preceding context, rationale, following context, baseline score, conditioned score, threshold, and decision—but should add what the public artifact omits: immutable source IDs, prompt/model revisions, filter scores, source-level licenses, retained-index manifests, and independent rationale-validity checks. The paper's human threshold calibration is a starting point, not a substitute for auditing the much larger Pile component.

The inference design is also relevant to test-time compute: a short learned rationale can act as latent information for ranking candidate steps without being injected directly into the agent's visible trajectory. The implicit-versus-explicit ablation suggests a useful hypothesis about robustness to noisy rationales, while the lack of a correctness verifier makes clear that search can still amplify a biased likelihood proxy.

Reuse should therefore separate three claims: the recipe is documented, the reported experiments show downstream gains, and the complete training corpus is openly reproducible. The first two have paper evidence; the third remains unsupported by the current 15,178-row release and repository state.

对“数据构建与开放发布配方”这一 track 而言，该论文是一个紧凑案例：当没有正确性验证器时，如何构建过程监督。它明确给出来源混合、生成的数据对象、预测性过滤信号、来源特定阈值、SFT 目标和下游搜索消费者。这些层次使其适合与使用执行器、符号求解器或专家过程标签过滤的数据配方进行比较。

实践者可以复用其概念 schema——来源、前文、rationale、后文、baseline 分数、条件分数、阈值和决策——但应补上公开 artifact 缺失的信息：不可变来源 ID、prompt/model revision、过滤分数、逐源 license、保留索引 manifest 和独立 rationale 有效性检查。论文的人工阈值校准可以作为起点，但不能替代对规模更大的 Pile 部分进行审计。

其推理设计也与测试时计算相关：简短的已学习 rationale 可以作为候选步骤排序的潜在信息，而不必直接写入 agent 可见轨迹。隐式与显式方法的消融提出了一个关于噪声 rationale 鲁棒性的有用假设；同时，缺少正确性验证器也说明搜索仍可能放大有偏的似然代理。

复用时应区分三个主张：构建配方是否有文档、报告实验是否显示下游提升、完整训练语料是否开放且可复现。前两项有论文证据；第三项仍不受当前 15,178 行发布和仓库状态支持。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the reported 79K as a constructed mixture, not as the verified size of the public HF dataset: the viewer exposes 15,178 rows. Keep the model roles separate—Llama-3-8B-Instruct inserts and scores training rationales, RATIONALYST predicts trajectory rationales, and the Llama agent proposes steps.
  • The construction verifier asks whether the observed continuation becomes more probable, not whether the rationale or candidate step is correct. Table 1 is the scale reference: GSM8K retains 19.5% of 17,566 candidates, ECQA 57.6% of 19,669, and Pile retention spans 2.6%–29.8% at threshold 0.
  • Do not normalize the 2,000-unit rule to tokens: the paper says words and tokens in different places, while the released script counts characters. Likewise, preserve the loss-sign conflict; code variables named perplexity actually sum log-probabilities.
  • Appendix H's finding that most retained Pile rationales describe preceding context is more direct evidence about rationale quality than benchmark gains. Table 2/model card give ECQA 75.2, while Table 5 gives 76.2.
  • The released inference script uses three candidates, temperature 0.7, seed 14, and at most 15 iterations. This is bounded likelihood-guided step selection, not an environment-verified rollout.
  • License claims are artifact-specific: ACL paper CC BY 4.0, HF model Apache-2.0, dataset unknown, and GitHub code unknown.

• 把报告的 7.9 万视为构建混合规模，而不是已验证的公开 HF 数据集规模：viewer 显示 15,178 行。还要区分三个模型角色——Llama-3-8B-Instruct 插入并评分训练 rationale，RATIONALYST 根据轨迹预测 rationale，Llama agent 提出步骤。
  • 构建验证器询问“已观察后文是否变得更可能”，不检查 rationale 或候选步骤是否正确。Table 1 是规模依据：GSM8K 在 17,566 个候选中保留 19.5%，ECQA 在 19,669 个候选中保留 57.6%，Pile 在阈值 0 下保留 2.6%–29.8%。
  • 不要把 2,000 单位统一写成 token：论文分别写过 word 和 token，公开脚本则计算字符。也不要静默修正 loss 符号冲突；代码中名为 perplexity 的变量实际累加 log-probability。
  • Appendix H 关于“大多数保留 Pile rationale 描述前文”的发现，比基准提升更直接地反映 rationale 质量。Table 2/model card 的 ECQA 是 75.2，Table 5 则是 76.2。
  • 公开推理脚本使用 3 个候选、温度 0.7、seed 14、最多 15 次迭代；这是有界似然引导步骤选择，不是经环境验证的 rollout。
  • license 必须逐 artifact 区分：ACL 论文为 CC BY 4.0，HF 模型为 Apache-2.0，数据集未知，GitHub 代码未知。

title: Citation

value.html: GSM8K and ECQA training examples plus reasoning-like documents selected from Pile-CC, StackExchange, GitHub, HackerNews, PubMed Central, and English Wikipedia.

A construction record pairs preceding context with an inserted implicit rationale and following context. The public dataset exposes the fields preceeding, rationale, and following, but does not expose source lineage or filter scores.

Llama-3-8B-Instruct inserts rationale targets during construction; the SFT-trained RATIONALYST generates trajectory-conditioned rationales at inference, while Llama-3-8B-Instruct proposes candidate next steps.
Offline rationale insertion and predictive filtering followed by iterative test-time selection among three candidate next reasoning steps for at most 15 iterations in the released inference script.

Construction uses 0.9-decayed following-token log-probability improvement, with human-calibrated thresholds for GSM8K/ECQA and threshold zero without rationale labels for Pile; inference uses rationale-conditioned candidate likelihood, not answer correctness or environment execution.

Construction intends to retain a rationale when it makes the continuation sufficiently more probable, although the paper's loss-difference sign and inequality are inconsistent. Inference stops on a dataset-specific answer cue or the released 15-iteration cap.
Llama-3-8B-Instruct is the base for the rationale generator and the evaluated reasoning agent.
Llama-3-8B-Instruct supplies inserted rationale targets and continuation scores.
Llama-3-8B-Instruct is prompted with demonstrations to insert <BOT>...<EOT> rationales without changing the surrounding text; RATIONALYST later predicts a rationale from the current trajectory.

The released extraction script uses Llama-3-8B-Instruct at temperature 0.0, seed 14, and maximum 3000 generated tokens. It is not an immutable record of the exact reported run and includes extra MATH/MMLU-Pro inputs beyond the paper's reported final mixture.

Pile candidates first require MPNet cosine similarity at least 0.3. Rationales are then retained by intended future-token predictiveness, with thresholds 1.2 for GSM8K, 0.5 for ECQA, and 0 for all six Pile subdomains. The paper and code disagree on sign notation and describe the Pile length cap as words, tokens, and characters in different places.
The released evaluation script samples three candidates per step at temperature 0.7 and seed 14, scores them with 0.9-decayed conditioned log-probability, and caps search at 15 iterations.

RATIONALYST is trained by token-level cross-entropy on rationale targets with prompt tokens masked. The released example job uses 20 epochs, per-device batch size 2, gradient accumulation 8, learning rate 2e-5, warmup ratio 0.03, cosine scheduling, and two-GPU FSDP; the paper does not confirm this file as the exact reported-run configuration.

Reported retained mixture: about 65K rationales from Pile-CC, StackExchange, GitHub, HackerNews, PubMed Central, and English Wikipedia, plus about 14K from GSM8K and ECQA. Table 1 reports source-level candidate counts and retention rates.

GSM8K and ECQA training data supply task-grounded construction examples. Evaluation uses GSM8K test, MATH test, ECQA validation, HellaSwag validation, ProofWriter depth-greater-than-5 test, ARC-Challenge test, and MMLU-Pro test.
